title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
plot_overview: A young woman searching for her unknown grandfather discovers a disturbing connection to a notorious criminal. As she follows the trail through accounts from people tied to his circle and newly uncovered records, she faces questions about family legacy and the growing strain on her relationship with her father.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re drawn to documentaries about family secrets, criminal history, and the search for personal identity; not for you if you prefer lighter stories or want to avoid disturbing subject matter.
review_summary: Pros: family legacy questions; newly uncovered records; competing accounts | Cons: disturbing subject matter; strained family relationship; unreliable narrators
